AUTOSAR AP R25-11
7.3.4.4.4.1 Triggering for data storage
[SWS_DM_00150] Primary trigger for event memory entry storage
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04211, RS_Diag_04105
⌈
Creating and storing memory entries (incl. collecting DTC-related data) shall be
triggered according to the
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.memoryEntryStor-
ageTrigger
configuration parameter (see [4]).
⌋
Note that for updating
snapshot record
and extended data information record spe-
cific configuration options are available. For details check the following sections.
[SWS_DM_01579] Behavior of not configured
DiagnosticMemoryDestina-
tion.memoryEntryStorageTrigger
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04211, RS_Diag_04105
⌈
If the optional parameter
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.memoryEntryStor-
ageTrigger
is not configured, the DM shall use a default value of ’testFailed’ for that
parameter.
⌋
7.3.4.4.4.2 Storage of
snapshot record
data
The fault memory manager provided by the DM is designed to be diagnostic protocol
independent. It receives states from monitors, operation cycles or conditions. Based
on this information it calculates DTC states, does aging, etc. Upon requests from a
diagnostic protocol the fault memory manager can provide the corresponding informa-
tion based on all the stored information. However for snapshot records (and as well
for extended data records) there is a protocol dependency due to the fact, that UDS
snapshot records contain DataIdentifiers (DIDs) and SOVD snapshot records contain
SOVD data. While both are of similar nature and provided as
environmental data
at a time a fault occurred, the interfaces towards the application to capture this data
have a protocol specific design (e.g. having UDS NRC code as possible return values
of a Read operation).
As result the DM uses two different snapshot records definitions for a DTC. One
used only for UDS which is defined by the

shotRecordContent
